txt: * * * olivia had just buttoned up her jeans and was reaching for her red wool peacoat when tony , one of vince 's personal guards , appeared in the doorway .
completely unaffected by his blunt statement , emerald larson stared across her highly polished louis xiv desk at one of her recently discovered grown grandchildren .
* * * elin stepped into the secluded room located in the far corner of the bar , trying not to project her nervousness .
just as kaderin was about to drop down and go a-torturing , an elf in a robe crossed to the altar at the back of the gallery - the altar that was off-center .
still breathing hard , i turned my head to look over at jeremiah hamilton standing at a small coffee bar on one side of the office .
he hit the call button , and the man who used to have julia under his thumb answered on the third ring .
i thought we might be going to the library of antiquities to speak to nickamedes about something or maybe even to the gym to talk to coach ajax , but instead , metis cut across the quad .
lorelei lifted her gaze to davido .
while i snuck a peek at teren , who was scrutinizing every move the man made , our captor spoke in an amused voice .
kincaid smirked , but before he could open his mouth to respond to my threat , another voice jumped into the mix .
